info.name: UserService (JACAG-5, JACAG-10)
info.description: Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner or one by one). Every run uses unique data and removes what it created. Needs the Authentication Service (authUrl) and the User Service (baseUrl). Before the run set the CURRENT values of adminLogin, adminPassword and internalKey (they are secrets and are not stored in this file). Folders 1-4 run as the admin; folder 5 checks the user role, the ownership rules and the internal key.
